_comment: ADR-037 manifest fragment — automation-designer. Registers the Automations page only; NO top-level menu entry, mirroring 20-business-rules.json's off-nav posture. Automations exist only as part of an app (reached from within the app builder), so the standalone /automations page stays routable for deep-links but is intentionally off the main nav. src/main.js mergeManifestFragments() concatenates pages onto src/manifest.json.

pages.title: Automations
pages._note: Custom page hosting the unified trigger→condition→actions automation designer (AutomationsPage.vue). Lists automations per ApplicationVersion and opens AutomationEditDialog / AutomationTestPanelModal. type:custom because the composer UI and dry-run sandbox are bespoke and no built-in page type covers them.
